selection_basis: Highest PR-AUC in the previous training-only hyperparameter search
threshold_policy: Maximize training OOF recall while requiring precision >= 0.90
imbalance_strategy: Stratified CV; compared class-weight options during tuning. Selected Gradient Boosting without resampling.
limitations: OOF threshold performance is optimistic because the model configuration was previously selected using the same training records.
Calibration is evaluated, not automatically corrected.
Final test metrics describe discrimination and prediction, not causal retention effects.
